notes.md: - **Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2025 (MoEFCC, NCAP, 130 cities; Sept 2025):** million-plus cities - **Indore 1st**, Jabalpur 2nd, Agra and Surat joint 3rd; 3-10 lakh - **Amravati 1st**; under 3 lakh - **Dewas (MP) 1st**, Parwanoo 2nd, Angul 3rd.
